fnol_text: My name is Leila Santos and I live at 638 Kestrel Street, Milton, VT 05463. You can reach me on (555) 888-3125 or leila.santos@example.com. A delivery driver slipped on our icy front steps on 10 January 2025 and was taken to hospital. They have said they will make a claim against us. Policy HH-2023-00166. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Santos on (555) 888-3125 to acknowledge the claim. Leila confirmed the loss date as 10 January 2025.
Site visit to 638 Kestrel Street. Neighbour Kwame Fitzgerald was present and confirmed the timeline.
Injured party Noor Nakamura sustained a sprained ankle and was treated at St. Brendan's Hospital. Do not admit liability; refer.
